notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000884887-26-000007, filed February 11, 2026), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A filed April 17, 2026, accession 0000884887-26-000017), as of April 9, 2026. LEADER, JUDGMENT CALL ON RELATION: Lisa Lutoff-Perlo was a named executive officer for 2020 to 2023 only; the 2026 proxy mentions her solely in the pay-versus-performance footnote listing those years' NEOs, and she is not in the directors-and-executive-officers ownership table, so status is no-reported-stake with values null. The schema has no value for the CEO of a subsidiary brand (Celebrity Cruises); 'former-ceo' is used and should be read as former brand CEO, not former CEO of Royal Caribbean Group. HOLDERS: the three largest 5% holders are listed; the proxy gives 13G/A or Form 4 filing dates (Capital International Investors February 13, 2026; Vanguard October 30, 2025; Capital Research Global Investors May 13, 2025), not the dates the holdings refer to, so asOf is null. Vanguard's footnote adds that on March 27, 2026 it reported an internal realignment (effective January 12, 2026) after which some subsidiaries report separately. BlackRock (7.5%), Capital World Investors (6.6%) and AWILHELMSEN AS (6.1%, the Wilhelmsen family of Norway, based on a Form 4 filed February 27, 2026) are the other 5% holders. No Pritzker entity appears in the 5% table. DIVIDENDS: cash paid in 2025 was $824 million (the cash-flow line). BUYBACKS: $1,159 million under the $1.0 billion program announced February 12, 2025 (completed November 2025) and the $2.0 billion program announced December 10, 2025; RCL had made no repurchases in 2024. GEOGRAPHY: the company's table is by cruise itinerary region, not customer location; 'North America' includes the United States, Canada, Mexico and the Caribbean. 'Other revenues' ($864 million: cancellation fees, vacation protection insurance, tours, port fees and services to affiliates) is not assigned to a region and is shown as its own row.
